_source: Windows Excel 16.0.20527 printing to 'Microsoft Print to PDF' (600 dpi), measured 2026-11-19 off xlsx-rounds/lookwin probes p206-lw (one workbook per face and weight; every ASCII character 0x21-0x7e five times in a row at every whole ppem 33-134, size = ppem x 0.12 pt, and p206s-lw its space, ten in a row; p207-lw the same in one column with the space, the weights p206 left out and 135-300; tools/mk_probe_hinted_advances_p206.py, read_p206.py, mk_probe_hinted_space_p206s.py, mk_probe_hinted_advances_p207.py, read_p207.py, build_hinted_advances.py): the printer dots a character's printed advance is off its design advance rounded to a whole dot (half up) -- GDI's hinted advances. faces: lower-case face (as the file names it and as Windows Excel draws it) -> R / B / I / BI -> ppem -> difference in dots -> the characters. Faces and weights whose advances are the rounded design ones are not listed (Courier New, ...). Read by notebooks.py FaceMeasure.printed and the web's printedAdvanceDots (lib/spreadsheet/office-hinted-advances.json is the same file).
